searchText: General question about RPC calls to kintsugi testnet. I was calling `eth_getTransactionReceipt` today and noticed that the `gasUsed` value is not the same as what the block scanner shows for most contract transactions. Where does this discrepancy come from? I double checked and the latest develop image uses the new one. Can you verify you're actually using the latest image (consensys/teku:develop)? That's what it's set to, shows `teku/v22.1.0+24-gb5558fc/linux-x86_64/-eclipseadoptium-openjdk64bitservervm-java-17` docker run consensys/teku:develop --version teku/v22.1.0+44-gf88438e/linux-aarch_64/-eclipseadoptium-openjdk64bitservervm-java-17 Very odd. Let me do a build with no-cache let me know 🙂 ``` docker run --rm consensys/teku:develop --version teku/v22.1.0+24-gb5558fc/linux-x86_64/-eclipseadoptium-openjdk64bitservervm-java-17 ``` I am confused Okay needed a docker pull. Shouldn't that have done that automatically when it changed? Thanks for taking a look! The block explorer actually shows the `gas` amount for a few minutes but then decreases along with the tx fee. For value transfer txs it goes from `21000` gas to `0` and for contract transactions it goes down significantly. I'm assuming that this may just be an issue with the UI since `eth_getTransactionReceipt` still has the correct values? Not sure where the best channel is to talk kintsugi but figured I'd throw this out here Hmm that might be the difference between intrinsic and real gas. Maybe there's an issue with some of the apis post merge. I'll investigate on monday
